pr_title: sql: replace dbdesc/schemadesc/typedesc Immutable types with catalog interfaces
pr_body:
This follows on a similar effort for tables: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/59495

Fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/62750
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/62755)

Review guide: these changes are, for the most part, unremarkable. I commented on the parts of the diff which are interesting (albeit only slightly so). There are three commits, one per type, but it's not more difficult to review the whole diff IMHO.
Thanks for the review! Rebasing again, just to make sure.

issue_context.title: sql: use catalog.*Descriptor instead of (dbdesc|schemadesc|typedesc).Immutable
issue_context.body: This is a child of #56306. Should be self-explanatory.

review_comments: These methods needed to be added to `catalog.TypeDescriptor` but they're straightforward getters.
These two new methods replace `LookupSchema`, I feel this is a better way to expose the contents of the `Schemas` map which is otherwise quite easy to misinterpret.
